deterministic_converter.channel_1_R: Normalized VV backscatter intensity (linear/dB with 1%-99% clipping)
deterministic_converter.channel_2_G: Normalized VH backscatter intensity (linear/dB with 1%-99% clipping)
deterministic_converter.documented_information_loss: Phase information and complex polarimetric covariance matrix [C2] collapsed to backscatter intensity and cross-ratio.

deterministic_converter.normalization: Surface reflectance clipped at 2000 DN (or standardized with train split stats: B04 mean 588.4 std 684.6, B03 mean 614.1 std 603.3, B02 mean 438.4 std 607.0)
deterministic_converter.documented_information_loss: Red-Edge bands (B05, B06, B07 for vegetation health), NIR (B08, B8A for biomass), and Short-Wave Infrared (SWIR B11, B12 for moisture/soil burn) are omitted from 3-channel RGB visual rendering.

annotations_per_image_distribution.risk: Uncontrolled sampling causes a few image pairs with 30+ binary questions to dominate training and cause repetitiveness.
annotations_per_image_distribution.duplicate_density_control_policy: Strict cap of at most 2 diverse annotations per unique image pair (e.g. 1 caption + 1 VQA or 1 grounding).

download_size.colab_disk_strategy: Never download the full 97 GB archives on Colab. Stream or download only the exact target image shards (~1.8-2.5 GB).
